title: AI 생성 메시 정리·LOD·일괄 내보내기 애드온
problem: AI가 만든 3D 메시는 스케일·중복 정점·재질 부재 등으로 바로 사용하기 어렵습니다. 제작 현장에서 일관된 정리와 LOD 생성, 일괄 내보내기를 자동화하면 시간을 크게 절약할 수 있습니다.

pipeline.action: 선택 객체에 회전·스케일 적용, 중복 정점 제거, 노멀 재계산
선택 객체를 지정 폴더에 GLTF(또는 FBX) 파일로 저장

script:
bl_info = {
    "name": "AI Asset Pipeline",
    "author": "3dflowhub",
    "version": (1, 0, 0),
    "blender": (3, 5, 0),
    "location": "View3D > Sidebar > AI Asset Pipeline",
    "description": "Clean, add LODs and batch export AI‑generated meshes.",
    "category": "Import-Export",
}

import bpy
import os

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Property group for addon settings
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
class AIPipelineSettings(bpy.types.PropertyGroup):
    export_dir: bpy.props.StringProperty(
        name="Export Folder",
        description="Folder to write exported files",
        subtype='DIR_PATH'
    )

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Operator: Clean and prepare selected meshes
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
class AIPIPE_OT_clean(bpy.types.Operator):
    bl_idname = "ai_pipe.clean"
    bl_label = "Clean Selected Meshes"
    bl_description = "Apply transforms, remove doubles, recalc normals, set origin"
    bl_options = {'REGISTER', 'UNDO'}

    @classmethod
    def poll(cls, context):
        return context.selected_objects

    def execute(self, context):
        for obj in context.selected_objects:
            if obj.type != 'MESH':
                continue
            # make object active for mesh ops
            bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
            obj.select_set(True)
            context.view_layer.objects.active = obj
            # apply rotation & scale (keep location)
            bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=True, scale=True)
            # enter edit mode for mesh cleanup
            bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT')
            bpy.ops.mesh.select_all(action='SELECT')
            # remove duplicate vertices
            bpy.ops.mesh.remove_doubles()
            # recalc normals outward
            bpy.ops.mesh.normals_make_consistent(inside=False)
            bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')
            # set origin to geometry center
            bpy.ops.object.origin_set(type='ORIGIN_GEOMETRY', center='BOUNDS')
            # ensure a basic material exists
            mat_name = "AI_Base_Mat"
            mat = (bpy.data.materials.get(mat_name) or bpy.data.materials.new(mat_name))
            if len(obj.data.materials) == 0:
                obj.data.materials.append(mat)
        self.report({'INFO'}, "Cleaned selected meshes")
        return {'FINISHED'}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Operator: Create LODs using Decimate modifier
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
class AIPIPE_OT_create_lod(bpy.types.Operator):
    bl_idname = "ai_pipe.create_lod"
    bl_label = "Create LODs"
    bl_description = "Duplicate selected objects and add Decimate modifiers for LODs"
    bl_options = {'REGISTER', 'UNDO'}

    @classmethod
    def poll(cls, context):
        return context.selected_objects

    def execute(self, context):
        lod_ratios = [("LOD1", 0.5), ("LOD2", 0.2)]
        original_objs = [obj for obj in context.selected_objects if obj.type == 'MESH']
        for obj in original_objs:
            for suffix, ratio in lod_ratios:
                lod_obj = obj.copy()
                lod_obj.data = obj.data.copy()
                lod_obj.name = f"{obj.name}_{suffix}"
                context.collection.objects.link(lod_obj)
                # add decimate modifier
                dec = lod_obj.modifiers.new(name="Decimate", type='DECIMATE')
                dec.ratio = ratio
                # apply modifier
                bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = lod_obj
                lod_obj.select_set(True)
                bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=dec.name)
                lod_obj.select_set(False)
        self.report({'INFO'}, "LOD objects created")
        return {'FINISHED'}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Operator: Export selected objects to GLTF (or FBX)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
class AIPIPE_OT_export(bpy.types.Operator):
    bl_idname = "ai_pipe.export"
    bl_label = "Export Selected"
    bl_description = "Export selected objects to the chosen folder as GLTF"
    bl_options = {'REGISTER'}

    @classmethod
    def poll(cls, context):
        return context.selected_objects and context.scene.ai_pipe_settings.export_dir != ""

    def execute(self, context):
        export_path = bpy.path.abspath(context.scene.ai_pipe_settings.export_dir)
        if not os.path.isdir(export_path):
            self.report({'ERROR'}, "Export folder does not exist")
            return {'CANCELLED'}
        filename = "ai_assets_export.gltf"
        full_path = os.path.join(export_path, filename)
        bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=full_path, export_selected=True, export_yup=True)
        self.report({'INFO'}, f"Exported to {full_path}")
        return {'FINISHED'}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# UI Panel
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
class AIPIPE_PT_panel(bpy.types.Panel):
    bl_label = "AI Asset Pipeline"
    bl_idname = "AIPIPE_PT_panel"
    bl_space_type = 'VIEW_3D'
    bl_region_type = 'UI'
    bl_category = "AI Pipeline"

    def draw(self, context):
        layout = self.layout
        settings = context.scene.ai_pipe_settings
        layout.prop(settings, "export_dir")
        layout.operator("ai_pipe.clean", icon='MODIFIER')
        layout.operator("ai_pipe.create_lod", icon='MESH_CUBE')
        layout.operator("ai_pipe.export", icon='EXPORT')

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Registration
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
classes = [
    AIPipelineSettings,
    AIPIPE_OT_clean,
    AIPIPE_OT_create_lod,
    AIPIPE_OT_export,
    AIPIPE_PT_panel,
]

def register():
    for cls in classes:
        bpy.utils.register_class(cls)
    bpy.types.Scene.ai_pipe_settings = bpy.props.PointerProperty(type=AIPipelineSettings)

def unregister():
    for cls in reversed(classes):
        bpy.utils.unregister_class(cls)
    del bpy.types.Scene.ai_pipe_settings

if __name__ == "__main__":
    register()
install: 2. Blender 편집기 상단 메뉴 > Edit > Preferences > Add‑ons 로 이동합니다.
3. 오른쪽 ‘Install…’ 버튼을 눌러 저장한 파일을 선택합니다.
usage: 2. ‘Export Folder’에 로컬 내보내기 폴더 경로를 지정합니다.
3. 정리할 메시에 대해 먼저 선택하고 ‘Clean Selected Meshes’ 버튼을 클릭합니다.
4. 필요 시 ‘Create LODs’ 버튼을 눌러 LOD1·LOD2를 자동 생성합니다.
5. 마지막으로 ‘Export Selected’ 버튼을 눌러 GLTF 파일을 지정 폴더에 저장합니다.
limits: AI 모델이 만든 텍스처 파일은 자동 연결되지 않으며 수동으로 지정해야 합니다.
LOD 비율은 고정값(0.5, 0.2)이며 사용자 정의는 지원하지 않습니다.
GLTF 외 다른 포맷은 현재 지원되지 않습니다.
